title: RBI Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) Scheme Operational Framework
source: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) / Government of India
content: Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs) are government securities denominated in grams of gold issued by the RBI on behalf of the Government of India. SGBs pay a fixed annual interest rate (typically 2.5% per annum on initial investment) paid semi-annually. Bonds carry an 8-year tenure with exit options available from the 5th year. Capital gains tax arising on redemption of SGBs to an individual investor at maturity is fully exempt from income tax.
